info.title: Renewlet Public API
info.description: Read-only API for subscriptions, status summaries, and upcoming due items. All endpoints require an `Authorization: Bearer rlt_*` token created in Renewlet settings.

get.summary: Inspect the current Public API token
get.description: Returns the read scope attached to the bearer token. It does not expose the token owner or token hash.

401.description: Missing, malformed, deleted, or unauthorized Public API token.

get.description: Returns an owner-scoped page of subscriptions ordered by Renewlet's Public API cursor contract.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as `data.nextCursor` from the previous page.

401.description: Missing, malformed, deleted, or unauthorized Public API token.

get.description: Returns one owner-scoped subscription by id. Foreign or missing ids return the same not found shape.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Subscription id from the list endpoint.

schema.description: Renewlet subscription id returned by the subscriptions list endpoint.

401.description: Missing, malformed, deleted, or unauthorized Public API token.

404.description: The requested resource does not exist for the token owner.

get.description: Returns total subscription count and counts by Renewlet status for the token owner.

401.description: Missing, malformed, deleted, or unauthorized Public API token.

get.description: Returns upcoming renewal, trial, or one-time expiry items within the requested day window.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Look-ahead window in days. The default is 30 and the maximum is 366.

401.description: Missing, malformed, deleted, or unauthorized Public API token.

PublicApiBearer.description: Renewlet Public API token. Query parameter tokens and browser session cookies are rejected.

balance.description: 手动记录的预付账户余额，与订阅价格独立；不自动扣减。未记录时省略，零是有效金额。

balanceCurrency.description: 余额的 ISO 4217 币种；与 balance 成对返回，不随订阅币种变化。

price.description: Canonical Renewlet decimal money string. Non-negative, max 1000000000, up to 6 fractional digits, no scientific notation.

anyOf.description: 日期字符串：必须是 YYYY-MM-DD，不接受带时间或时区的 ISO datetime。

nextBillingDate.description: 日期字符串：必须是 YYYY-MM-DD，不接受带时间或时区的 ISO datetime。

trialEndDate.description: 日期字符串：必须是 YYYY-MM-DD，不接受带时间或时区的 ISO datetime。

joinedDate.description: Renewlet date-only string in YYYY-MM-DD format. No time or time zone.

customAmount.description: Canonical Renewlet decimal money string. Non-negative, max 1000000000, up to 6 fractional digits, no scientific notation.
